title: Agents get a tool directory and audio transcription
summary:
Agents gained a tool directory and transcription, model and media routes expanded, and concurrent requests got more reliable accounting.

Managed-agent creation and runtime routes were added alongside a hosted MCP registry. Agents can select listed servers and load their tools through Gen, while MCP clients gain `transcribeAudio` for audio at public HTTPS URLs. The CLI gained agent and model commands, and the API reference gained an endpoint-agent request example.

Handlers were added for MiniMax H3, Qwen Image 3, Seedance 2.5, and a fal-backed Z-Image route. Identical long-running media requests can rejoin an in-progress job or retrieve its completed cache entry, and the documented synchronous media limit rose from 120 to 300 seconds. Kontext image generation and single-reference editing were restored through a Black Forest Labs provider route; separate fixes tightened Kontext error reporting and Mistral Small 2603 routing.

A community contribution made finite API-key budgets reserve estimated Pollen charges atomically, so simultaneous requests cannot each spend the same remaining budget. The reservation is adjusted to the actual charge or released when appropriate. Fallback tracking now identifies the provider attempt that settled a request across modalities, and empty streaming responses from generic OpenAI and Azure Responses clients become retryable errors rather than fabricated output.

daily.title: Managed agents gain tools
daily.text: Create managed agents and choose tools from a hosted MCP registry. Agent and model commands were also added to the CLI. [Read the MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Transcribe audio with MCP
daily.text: The new `transcribeAudio` tool turns audio from a direct public HTTPS URL into text, with optional model, language, and prompt fields. [Read the MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Longer media requests
daily.text: Identical long-running media requests can rejoin an in-progress job or retrieve its completed cache entry. The documented synchronous media limit is now 300 seconds, up from 120. [Explore the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.text: A model handler was added for MiniMax H3. [Find MiniMax H3](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=MiniMax%20H3).
